mapper.select: SELECT comment_id, comment_content, comment_type, target_id, comment_status, created_at, updated_at, member_id FROM tb_comment WHERE target_id = #{momentId} AND comment_type = 'MOMENT' AND comment_status = true ORDER BY created_at DESC
